verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service that processes user files, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no such policy, opt-out, or commitment. File deletion and expiry controls (zamzar-docs-3, zamzar-docs-20) are adjacent data-retention features, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.
